findings.rule: coding-standards rule 7 (no dead/duplicated code) — doubt stated, since this mirrors the file's existing lazy-import convention for other sibling packages
findings.summary: `from lessons import index as lessons_mod` is imported separately in both `_supersedes_problem` (line 1613) and `lesson_and_eval` (line 1635) instead of once and passed through.

findings.rule: doubt stated: spec.md's determinism bullet does not call for escaping, and no source file or test exercises such a title today
findings.summary: `_render_line`/`_render_unsorted_line` interpolate `title`/`description`/the first heading into `[text](file)` with no escaping, so a value containing `]` or `(` would break the generated markdown link.

findings.rule: doubt stated: low impact since an empty directory is not tracked by git and nothing commits it, but every other gate check in plugin/gate/checks.py is read-only on the filesystem
findings.summary: `build()` (called by `check()`) always runs `lessons_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`, so the read-only `index.py check` (and `lesson_and_eval`'s call to it) creates `lessons/` as a side effect even when it reports drift or failure.
